source_finding.improvement_in_g9: G9 correctly proposes holding DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY mechanism presence constant while varying content and using a condition-blind downstream semantic observer.
source_finding.remaining_confound: With only two fixed content-addressed payloads, preregistered semantic meaning is perfectly collinear with exact payload identity. A downstream path can therefore branch on raw bytes, digest, payload length, token pattern, serialization identity, or a lookup keyed by payload identity and still produce a stable counterbalanced A/B outcome difference without demonstrating causal sensitivity to semantic equivalence classes.
source_finding.scope_consequence: Such a result may support exact payload-identity/content-token causality at its measured scope, but it is insufficient by itself for a claim worded as semantic-content causality.

counterexample.setup: Let CONTENT_A and CONTENT_B both traverse the same validated DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY path. A downstream implementation maps digest(A)->OUTCOME_A and digest(B)->OUTCOME_B without interpreting task semantics. Four fresh-process counterbalanced A/B trials are perfectly stable and the condition-blind observer sees the expected outcome difference.
g9_style_observation: A and B have different canonical downstream outcomes
counterexample.falsifying_probe: Introduce a representation-variant A2 that is independently preregistered as task-semantically equivalent to A but has a distinct exact payload representation/digest. If the effect follows digest identity rather than the preregistered semantic equivalence class, semantic-content causality is unproven.

semantic_equivalence_discriminator.minimum_design: Add at least one independent representation variant per semantic class, with the semantic-equivalence relation defined before execution by a treatment-blind deterministic task-semantic contract/evaluator. Hold transport, recipient, delivery, uptake, reentry, task/pre-state, executor, plan, runtime context and observation mechanics constant. Test that downstream behavior is invariant within a semantic class across representation changes and discriminative across preregistered different semantic classes.
minimum_matrix: S1_R1: semantic class S1, representation R1
S1_R2: same preregistered semantic class S1, distinct exact representation/digest R2
S2_R1: semantic class S2, representation R3

hard_negatives: If S1_R1 and S1_R2 produce materially different task-semantic outcomes solely because representation/digest changed, semantic-content credit remains zero.

If the semantic-equivalence evaluator receives treatment arm, expected outcome, payload digest identity, delivery/uptake/reentry result, or downstream observed outcome when defining equivalence, fail closed as circular.
If mechanical payload differences such as size/timing/token count are not bounded or matched and can explain the outcome, classify MECHANICAL_CONTENT_CONFOUND rather than semantic causality.
If only two fixed payload identities are exercised, restrict any positive claim to exact payload/content-identity causality and keep semantic-equivalence generalization unproven.
If representation variants do not independently traverse validated DELIVERY->UPTAKE->REENTRY, classify mechanism-path mismatch/UNKNOWN.
